capabilities: Convert PDF files to Markdown on-device with a vision model
Export notes to EPUB with figures and equation crops embedded
Send EPUBs to Kindle via Amazon's Send to Kindle app
Detect and repair truncated LaTeX formulas from conversion
Organize converted papers into folders named by document title
disambiguation: Not a Markdown line-rewriting formatter; it converts PDF documents into Markdown and EPUB.
extras: Desktop only; first conversion downloads ~1 GB of model weights from Hugging Face; Windows and Linux are untested; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: every existing option gives up one of effortless, complete (figures + LaTeX + tables), or local
motivation: The author argues Markdown is becoming the best human reading format and that open-source PDF-to-text engines are packaged for developers rather than end users, so a local, effortless converter was needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn PDFs into readable Markdown, and existing converters are cloud-based, need API keys, or require a Python environment.

relations.evidence: a single compact VLM (granite-docling-258M, official ONNX export, Apache-2.0) running under transformers.js
If you browse by folder and want the folder itself to open the note in one click, the Folder Notes community plugin does exactly that

summary: Converts PDFs to clean Markdown with a local vision model and exports notes to EPUB for e-readers, preserving figures, tables and math.
